topology.source: Windows core topology intersected with process affinity

dataset.format: GMDS v1, converted physical CarpetX ADM
dataset.payload_policy: immutable read-only mmap; active snapshots globally physically validated; payload never pickled

metric.acceleration_policy: strict float64 CPU ADM interpolation kernels; reference NumPy reconstruction; no fastmath; reference evaluation resolves rejected/ill-conditioned queries; fallback counts include rejected queries
metric.temporal_interpolation: piecewise linear saved ADM; right-sided standalone knots, incoming closed-slab tracing
metric.derivative_method: analytic interpolation-weight and ADM inverse chain rule; AMR weight gradients included
metric.background: none unless explicit finite-boundary model configured; data exits are unresolved
